title: Histoire ancienne de l'Eglise
author: Louis Duchesne
current_text: Pope Pius X placed Histoire ancienne de l'Eglise on the Index in January 1912 because he considered it too modernist; Louis Duchesne accepted the decision and remained a priest in good standing.

sources.quote: Mais ses travaux inquiètent la hiérarchie catholique à tel point que le pape Pie X, principal adversaire du modernisme qu'il condamne en 1907 dans l'encyclique Pascendi, juge son Histoire ancienne de l'Église trop moderniste et la met à l' Index en janvier 1912.
sources.title: Louis Duchesne — Wikipédia

sources.quote: In 1912 his Histoire ancienne de l'Église was placed on the Index of Forbidden Books. Duchesne submitted to the decision and remained a priest in good standing, but he published little further history during his lifetime.
sources.title: Louis Marie Olivier Duchesne | BiblicalTraining Library
